headline: Turn long source notes into drafts clinicians can verify quickly
capabilities: Automatically generate concise, clinically relevant patient summaries
Surface key risks, comorbidities, and medication considerations
Standardize documentation to support smoother surgical and anesthesia workflows
Send summaries through EHR and secure messaging systems
outcomes: Completed chart reviews faster with consistent output
Improved clinical safety by proactively flagging conditions and medications
Reduced coordination delays across care teams with complete, ready‑to‑use summaries
Improved physician productivity and rate of clearances delivered
why_try: The demo shows a transparent summarization pattern: every output separates source facts from clinical interpretation and reminds the reviewer to compare the draft with the authorized record.

sample_prompts.label: Summarize the source encounter
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize synthetic encounter SYN-ENC-001 using source facts only.

sample_prompts.label: Inventory recorded medications
sample_prompts.prompt: List the source-recorded medications for SYN-ENC-001 for reconciliation.

sample_prompts.label: Extract the problem list
sample_prompts.prompt: Extract the source-coded problems for SYN-ENC-001 without confirming a diagnosis.

sample_prompts.label: Review referral context
sample_prompts.prompt: What referral context is recorded for SYN-ENC-001, and what action has not occurred?

business_flow: Physicians, surgeons, anesthesia teams, and clinical coordinators
Dynamics 365 or approved read-only healthcare record interface
